chunks: From him, from Mu'awiya ibn Hakim, from Abu Malik al-Hadrami, from Abu al-Abbas al-Qabbagh, who said:
I entered upon Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), and he said to me: 'Narrate from me that whoever divorces his wife three times in one sitting, she has become permanently divorced from him.'
ai.seo_question: Does a triple divorce count if all three pronouncements are made in one sitting?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Istibsar*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) confirms the validity of a triple divorce pronounced simultaneously in one session, a ruling that distinguishes the Shia view from some Sunni schools regarding the immediacy of separation. This narration underscores the principle that the utterance of three divorces, even without the standard waiting periods (*iddah*) between each, constitutes a final and irrevocable dissolution of the marriage bond.
